notes.title: Version update v1.1.4.842-5410ae48
notes.notes:
Added Ctrl+V paste and Win+V clipboard paste, supporting pasting content into the currently open folder. Specifically includes the following content:

[list]
[*] [b]Images from Clipboard[/b]: Paste image data from the clipboard and save it as a local file.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258046/4cdaf054f546d3ede26dda680bcef71f14057e29.png[/img]
[*] [b]Network Files[/b]: Support pasting network file URLs with http, https, and file protocols, and download the files to the currently open folder.
[*] [b]Local Files[/b]: Paste local files.
[*] [b]File Paths[/b]: Paste file paths and process the corresponding files.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.0.762-139a5a22 Major Update
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Users,[/b]

We sincerely apologize for the issues in the previous version that resulted in poor user experience, high memory usage, and unresponsiveness. After approximately three weeks of effort, we have made several optimizations and improvements, including:

[olist]
[*] Optimized user experience, improved performance, and reduced memory usage.
[*] Increased startup, loading, and response speeds.
[*] Added a volume adjustment slider and mute button to the menu bar.
[*] Added functionality to switch media files using the [↑] and [↓] keys on the preview page.
[*] Added the ability to drag files from within the software to the Windows File Explorer.
[*] Added the ability to save the expanded state of the folder tree.
[*] Modified the drag-and-drop graphic style.
[*] Adjusted the position of the video preview progress bar to improve video response speed.
[*] Fixed issue where the [F11] key and the fullscreen button on the video interface were unresponsive after toggling fullscreen.
[*] Ignored [Desktop.ini], [.Swordfish], and other files and folders.
[*] Removed the library scan notification.
[*] Temporarily hid folder thumbnails, which will be restored in the next version.
[*] We hope these improvements will provide you with a smoother and more efficient user experience. If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions during use, please do not hesitate to contact us. Your feedback is very important to us and will help us continuously improve and refine our product.
[/olist]

Thank you for your patience and valuable feedback. We wish you a pleasant experience!

Best regards, The Team
